1200.en_des: Used to enhance Awakened Artifact. Each enhancement attempt has a chance to fail. On failure, the affected attribute's level -1.

formulas.enhance_success: P(n) = 1 - (1 - success[level]/100)^n   # n = stones spent in ONE attempt
formulas.enhance_display: client renders Math.trunc of the IEEE754 double -> 20% shows as 19%, 36% as 35%
formulas.refine_weight: w[a] = 1000 + sum(material_delta[a]); locked attrs -> p=1 and removed from pool
formulas.refine_prob: p[a] = w[a] * randomAttrNum / sum(w); iterative clamp: drop a if p<0.01, force p=1 if p>=1
formulas.enhance_failure: failure moves the attribute EXACTLY -1 level, independent of n; floor at level 1; all n stones are consumed. CONFIRMED by live test on Global 2026-08-07: n=1 Lv10->Lv9, n=2 Lv11->Lv10.
formulas.enhance_attempt_model: n stones = ONE atomic attempt (one C2SEquipUpgradeAttrRequest, one result). NOT n sequential rolls.
formulas.refine_level_reroll: A refined stat gets a RANDOMISED level, capped at the current level. Working model: uniform 1..currentLevel. Server-side, in no config. Evidence: 7 samples from a Lv10 source -> 10,5,1,4,2,2,10; none above 10 (p=0.78% if the draw were 1..20). Exact shape inside the range unconfirmed at n=7. The current stat is NOT excluded from the pool - it can re-roll into itself at a different level.

refine_prob_check.setup: slot-2 pool, 1 open slot, one equip 130101 as material
